title: Classification of Subnets of Conformal Nets
exact_target: Characterize every conformal subnet using enough information to go beyond the parent net\textquotesingle s representation category.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004280 (OWR-17292-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 28, 29.
Bischoff--Del Vecchio--Giorgetti, quantum operations on conformal nets (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The target is classification for a given net, not reconstruction from $\operatorname{Rep}(\mathcal A)$ alone. Source assumptions such as irreducibility, index and covariance must be stated in an actual characterization.
